```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
all_fields <- read_csv("../data/AnalysisData/20260723_all_fields.csv")
```


## checks

```{r}
nrow(all_fields)
colSums(is.na(all_fields))
levels(as.factor(all_fields$crop))
levels(as.factor(all_fields$crop_unified))
levels(as.factor(all_fields$tree_species))
levels(as.factor(all_fields$distance_to_tree_strip))
```

## map of study locations

```{r}
study_locations <- all_fields %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
  group_by(field) %>%
  summarise(lat = mean(lat), lon = mean(lon), .groups = "drop")

germany <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Germany", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = germany, fill = "grey95") +
  geom_point(data = study_locations, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = field), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Field")
```

## observations per year by study

```{r}
all_fields %>%
  count(year, field) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = field)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "observations per year", x = "year", y = "number of observations")
```

```{r}
all_fields %>%
  count(year, field) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = field)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(~field) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "observations per year", x = "year", y = "number of observations")

```


## yield distribution

```{r}
ggplot(all_fields, aes(x = yield_tha)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "distribution of yield", x = "yield", y = "count")
```

## straw distribution

```{r}
ggplot(all_fields, aes(x = yield_straw_tha)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "distribution of straw yield", x = "yield straw", y = "count")
```

## observations per crop

```{r}
all_fields %>%
  count(crop_unified) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(crop_unified, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "forestgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "observations per crop", x = "crop", y = "count")
```

## na overview

```{r}
na_by_field <- all_fields %>%
  group_by(field) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-field, names_to = "column", values_to = "na_share")

ggplot(na_by_field, aes(x = column, y = field, fill = na_share)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "share of na per column, by study", fill = "na share")
```
